lead.event: HSC stock exclusions increase big-bank weights in the IHSG
lead.headline: HSC stock exclusion raises BBCA, BBRI and BMRI's combined IHSG weight to 25.4%
lead.blurb: Excluding High Shareholding Concentration stocks from the IHSG calculation left Bank Central Asia and Bank Rakyat Indonesia at the 9% cap each. Bank Mandiri’s weight rose from 5.9% to 7.4%. Analysts warned the greater concentration makes the IHSG more sensitive to banking-sector sentiment. One report said a simultaneous 1% decline in the three banks could pressure the index by roughly 0.25%.
lead.copy_decision: rewritten: moved from story to lead

earnings_guidance.event: BBCA raises its 2026 loan growth target
earnings_guidance.headline: BBCA raises 2026 loan growth target to 10%-11%
earnings_guidance.blurb: BCA cited resilient corporate and SME lending amid tightening industry liquidity, while consumer lending remains weak as quarterly auto loan repayments exceed new bookings. Management expects 2027 loan growth to be broadly similar to 2026.

earnings_guidance.event: Bank Permata reports lower Q3 net profit
earnings_guidance.headline: BNLI reports nine-month net profit down 10.9% to Rp2.57 trillion
earnings_guidance.blurb: Bank Permata's net interest and sharia income fell 2.49% to Rp7.38 trillion, while gains on sales of investment securities dropped 59.25%. Loans rose 10.1% to Rp172.9 trillion, and gross NPL improved to 2.1% from 2.2%.

earnings_guidance.event: PTBA reports a sharp increase in nine-month net profit
earnings_guidance.headline: PTBA reports nine-month net profit up 216.4% to Rp4.41 trillion
earnings_guidance.blurb: Bukit Asam's revenue rose 12.4% to Rp35.2 trillion, driven by higher average selling prices. Citi views its business and stock prospects as attractive, citing potential coal quota increases, improved domestic selling prices and minimal logistics disruptions.

earnings_guidance.event: ACES reports nine-month results and lags its 2026 store-expansion target
earnings_guidance.headline: ACES reports 9M26 profit up 25.7% as store openings trail target
earnings_guidance.blurb: By August, Aspirasi Hidup Indonesia had opened 15 AZKO and 16 NEKA stores, versus 2026 targets of 25-30 and 40-50. Nine-month sales rose 8.3% to Rp6.9 trillion, while capex of Rp144.8 billion represented about 32%-36% of its annual budget, suggesting some expansion could shift to 2027.

market_structure_policy.event: IDX suspends MKNT trading and probes its share-price surge
market_structure_policy.headline: IDX suspends MKNT after 3,100% rise and probes trading
market_structure_policy.blurb: Mitra Komunikasi Nusantara shares rose from Rp1 to Rp32 and hit the upper price limit for 14 consecutive trading days from 15 October. The halt covers the Regular and Cash Markets from the 6 November pre-opening session until further notice, while IDX is investigating the volatile trading under letter No. S-13822/BEI.PP1/11-2026, dated 4 November.
market_structure_policy.copy_decision: rewritten: 1 new articles with a new fact: IDX was investigating the volatile trading under letter No. S-13822/BEI.PP1/11-2026 dated 4 November 2026.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: KB Bank postpones its planned US dollar global bond issuance
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: BBKP postpones planned US$300 million global bond issuance
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: KB Bank cited global and domestic market conditions affecting funding costs and terms, and reported a Q3 2026 net loss of Rp184.17 billion and a gross NPL ratio of 10.26% in September. Its US$300 million notes issued in October 2024 mature on 30 October 2027, with shareholder support and domestic issuance among the alternatives.
capital_raising_buybacks.copy_decision: rewritten: moved from flash to story

capital_raising_buybacks.event: GOTO buyback and cancellation of treasury shares
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: GOTO shareholders approve cancellation of around 32 billion treasury shares
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: GoTo had spent Rp985 billion to repurchase 36 billion shares by 29 October, with roughly Rp2.5 trillion remaining under its authorization through June 2027. Shareholders approved removing shares equal to about 2.7% of total shares outstanding from issuance on 14 October, raising existing investors’ ownership percentages and preventing the shares from returning to the market.
capital_raising_buybacks.copy_decision: rewritten: moved from flash to story

deals_control.event: DOOH agrees to acquire a 29.88% stake in INET and announces related corporate actions
deals_control.headline: DOOH completes Rp2 trillion purchase of 29.88% stake in INET
deals_control.blurb: Era Media Sejahtera’s subsidiary CNI executed the purchase of 6.68 billion INET shares at Rp300 each from controlling shareholder AKUN through the IDX negotiation market. DOOH seeks shareholder approval on 9 November for a rights issue of up to 154.77 billion shares and other corporate actions.
deals_control.copy_decision: rewritten: moved from lead to story

deals_control.event: Bakrie Kalila Investment sells ENRG shares
deals_control.headline: ENRG shareholder Bakrie Kalila sells shares for Rp312.66 billion
deals_control.blurb: Energi Mega Persada shareholder Bakrie Kalila's reported sale figures differ on the quantity and timing. One report says its holding stood at 6.44% after a further 5 million shares were sold on 3 November, while Syailendra Bakrie's Shima Global Kapital sold 14 million shares and retained 11.65%.

deals_control.event: Takjub Finansial Teknologi sells a 9% stake in BNBA
deals_control.headline: Takjub Finansial sells 9% stake in BNBA
deals_control.blurb: It sold 304.92 million shares at Rp777 apiece on 2 November for about Rp236.92 billion. Its ownership fell from 33.45% to 24.45%, and it said it is not BNBA’s controlling shareholder and does not control the bank. The sale was reported to OJK on 5 November, according to an IDX disclosure.
